name: get_element_data
description: Get comprehensive information for elements including parameter values, types, and modification capabilities

elementIds.description: Element IDs to analyze for complete parameter information

outputOptions.description: Output options controlling which element data to include. Default is BasicElementInfo.

basicElementInfo.description: Include the element name, category, family, type and level in output

elementClass.description: Include the element class in output

boundingBox.description: Include element bounding box in output

revitInstanceId.description: Process ID of the Revit instance to call. Use get_running_revit_instances to list available instances.
